subject: Commercial Launch Plan — OTLP Relay Partnership (Datadog + Grafana pilots)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Datadog Partnerships <partnerships@datadog.com>, ApexOps Consulting <sarah@apexops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial Launch Plan — OTLP Relay Partnership (Datadog + Grafana pilots)

Hi all,

Thanks again for the sync earlier this week. Putting a short, actionable plan in one place so we can align on pilot readiness and commercial milestones. High level ask: can Datadog and Grafana commit to a two-month pilot window for their customers with ApexOps as the systems integrator? If yes, we can target a public marketplace listing after the pilot and a joint launch webinar in June.

Proposed milestones (first pass):
- Week 0 (Mar 15): kickoff + environment access
- Week 1–2: integration QA, auth + packaging validation (SAML/OIDC + example OTLP schema)
- Week 3–6: pilot with 3 customers (2 Datadog customers, 1 Grafana customer via ApexOps)
- Week 7–8: finalize marketplace assets, pricing guidance, launch comms

Immediate asks from partners:
1) ApexOps — confirm service lead and resource ramp (technical PM + 2 engineers)
2) Datadog — share marketplace integration checklist & SSO requirements
3) Grafana — confirm plugin packaging constraints and any security QA steps

I've attached a one-page timeline and a SOW stub (ApexOps can iterate). Once we have confirmations I'll send a mutual action plan and invite a weekly 30-min standup.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
[attachment: RDW-OTLP-relay-timeline-v1.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: RDW-ApexOps-SOW-draft.docx (docx)]

From: Sarah Mitchell <sarah@apexops.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Datadog Partnerships <partnerships@datadog.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Commercial Launch Plan — OTLP Relay Partnership (Datadog + Grafana pilots)

Jonas,

Appreciate the clear timeline. ApexOps can lead the pilot integration work. Confirmed resources: myself (engagement lead), Priya N. (technical PM), Alan R. (senior SRE), and two contractors for short validation sprints. We can start ramping March 15–19.

A few clarifying questions from our engineers:
- Can you share the expected OTLP envelope and any Redwood-specific attributes we should preserve (trace/service tags)?
- What are the acceptance criteria for the pilot (latency thresholds, error-rate targets, and stability windows)?
- Any minimum data retention or audit log export requirements for compliance audits?

I'll loop in our technical lead on the next thread. We reviewed the SOW stub; we'll provide redlines by Tue 9 Mar.

—Sarah
Sarah Mitchell
Director, Solutions & Integrations | ApexOps Consulting
sarah@apexops.com | +1 (646) 222-9901

Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial Launch Plan — OTLP Relay Partnership (Datadog + Grafana pilots)

Hi Jonas and Sarah,

Thanks — this is promising. A few items from the Datadog side before we commit to marketplace timing:

1) Security checklist: please provide an auth matrix (SAML/OIDC endpoints) and a short security brief describing private key handling. We have a vendor security questionnaire that our legal team will send; attaching the top-line checklist here.
2) Packaging: our marketplace requires a validated container and an install manifest (Helm/OPA rules). Any prebuilt artifacts from Redwood will speed certification.
3) Observability hooks: we'll need an example OTLP configuration to validate attribute mapping into Datadog traces and metrics — especially service.name, environment, and any custom agent tags.

Can you share the initial artifacts by EOD Wednesday (Mar 10)? If so, Datadog legal will fast-track review and we can lock in the pilot kickoff for Mar 15.

Best,
Partnerships Team
Datadog
[attachment: Auth-checklist-datadog.xlsx (xlsx)]

Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 07:58:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial Launch Plan — OTLP Relay Partnership (Datadog + Grafana pilots)

Thanks for the fast responses and the checklist — appreciate it. Attached are the artifacts Datadog asked for:
- OTLP-example.yaml (inlined in the Drive link) — includes required service.* and dataset tags
- Auth matrix with SAML/OIDC endpoints and key rotation cadence
- SOW draft with roles/responsibilities called out (ApexOps to confirm resource dates)

Acceptance criteria proposal (short):
- Latency: median additional ingestion latency < 50ms for 95th percentile under pilot load profile
- Error tolerance: sustained error rate < 0.5% over 30-minute windows
- Stability: 99.5% availability for the relay for the pilot period

Action items:
- ApexOps: provide redlines to SOW by EOD Tue (Mar 11) — Priya to lead
- Datadog: confirm legal review window and certify the container manifest by Mar 12
- Camila: will prepare marketplace asset checklist for Grafana packaging constraints

I'll open a weekly calendar invite for the standup (starting Mar 15).

Attachments referenced: RDW-ApexOps-SOW-draft.docx, Auth-checklist-datadog.xlsx

Cheers,
Jonas

All,

Reviewed the SOW and the acceptance criteria Jonas proposed — looks good from a commercial and GTM perspective. Approved to proceed with the Mar 15 kickoff provided:
- ApexOps confirms resource dates by EOD Mar 11
- Datadog confirms container manifest certification window by Mar 12

Camila — can you own the marketplace asset checklist and the Grafana packaging notes? If you can share a short template by Fri (Mar 12) we can ensure the launch comms are ready.

I'll escalate to marketing to reserve the webinar slot for mid-June pending pilot success.

Thanks,
